# Security policy

This repository is the static website served at https://www.marcosaureliousmedia.com/
(and https://marcosaurelious.github.io/marcos-garcia-author/). It has no server,
database, accounts or forms.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security problems privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/MarcosAurelious/marcos-garcia-author/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue with exploit details.

The same contact is published at `/.well-known/security.txt`.
